prompt: A single emblem for the back of every card in Sun Wukong's deck: his somersault cloud (jindou yun), drawn as a classic Chinese auspicious cloud scroll curling into a bold, round, balanced shape with spiralling ruyi heads and a short trailing tail, as carved on a Ming dynasty lacquer box. Rendered in worn gold leaf with touches of jade and cinnabar red, rustic 1990s hand-painted style, symmetrical and centred on a fully transparent background. No characters, no letters, no words, no circle or badge behind it.
